# AI Academy

> AI Academy is a free, beginner-friendly educational sharing platform designed to help anyone learn artificial intelligence through clear, step-by-step guides and daily paper breakdowns.

## Core Learning Paths
- [Learn AI for Beginners](/): Foundational concepts, hands-on tutorials, and practical guides explained in plain language.
- [Daily Research Papers](/papers): Daily simplified breakdowns of landmark and emerging AI research papers.

## Key Features
- Step-by-step guides without complex math barriers
- Interactive, project-based AI learning
- Daily curated research paper summaries for curious builders

## Available Courses
- [30 Days of AI Challenge](/course/30-days-of-ai): The ultimate 30-day guide to the vocabulary, mechanics, and future of Artificial Intelligence. From NLP fundamentals to AGI — no programming required. 4 chapters, 30 lessons.
- [Hybrid RAG Systems](/course/hybrid-rag): Master retrieval-augmented generation with hybrid search, re-ranking, multi-hop reasoning, and production-grade RAG pipelines. 4 chapters, 30 lessons.

## Upcoming Courses
- Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Workflows: Build autonomous AI agents that plan, reason, and collaborate.
- Fine-Tuning & LLMOps: Learn to fine-tune foundation models and deploy custom LLMs at scale.
- Multimodal AI & Computer Vision: Explore image generation, video understanding, and spatial intelligence.

## About
AI Academy is created by Shoaib Alam, an AI Engineer at JPMC and NLP Researcher at IIT Gandhinagar, published at EMNLP 2024 (LEGOBench). The platform bridges cutting-edge AI research with accessible, beginner-friendly education.
